method: Full source inspection of every declaration and its assertions, nested rows, production owner and caller/overlap context; runtime names joined to declaration decisions. Verdicts are engineering recommendations, not per-test mutation scores. Five targeted mutations survived and one negative control was killed; all sources restored. See evidence.json.

verdicts.R: Retain: independent useful proof at this boundary.
verdicts.F: Repair: consumer promise is needed but present proof is weak, coupled or incomplete. Keep until replaced.
verdicts.C: Consolidate: move named unique cases/assertions into the cited keeper before retiring this declaration.
verdicts.D: Delete candidate: no distinct useful proof or obsolete test-only path. Honor explicit dependencies before removal.
verdicts.N: Diagnostic environment marker, not active product proof.
